name: generic-resource-graph-productization-phase1
description: Retained-artifact coverage for the first productizable exact-live-capture subset. This plan intentionally covers only the modeled finite stdio pipe product marker and its support/refusal evidence; broader Redis/database/service candidates remain deferred until their product boundary is separately proven.
nonClaims: Phase 1 productization does not add arbitrary process restore support.
Phase 1 productization does not add broad daemon, service, or database migration support.
Phase 1 productization does not add active session migration, source-fd teleportation, source-ISA emulation, metadata-only success, or runtime-profile shortcuts.
Redis/database, same-arch continuation, cross-arch semantic reconstruction, and proof-only descriptor harnesses remain outside this phase-1 product subset.
